title: pleiocarpidia capituligera
intro: Pleiocarpidia capituligera, commonly known as "kayu putih", is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is a traditional medicinal plant used for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Pleiocarpidia capituligera include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
